name: visual-parity-walkthrough
description: Interactive capture-and-diff walkthrough of a ported UI against its reference implementation: the user drives and captures, the agent verdicts each capture live, and the session ends in a ranked evidence-backed improvement list plus a decisions ledger.

safety.scope: read-only: the walkthrough analyzes and recommends; it never changes code
safety.evidence: every finding needs a capture plus port and reference file:line cites, or an explicit user-concurred aesthetic call
safety.motionVerdicts: animation pace rulings belong to the user per animation; never inferred from frames
safety.decisionsLedger: every acceptance, ruling, and unvetoed assumption must land in the report, not only in chat
